Verify Effect compilation, texture/color/alpha blend, complete 2s loop, extrema, interrupt/reset, and actual built Web output before any runtime PASS. Draw Call increment <=1 is hard cap and 0 only optimization target; mask planned R8 raw increment 32768 bytes, but actual imported GPU format/allocation must be measured and total incremental resident mask memory <=0.25 MiB, with no 4 MiB body duplicate. CPU/GPU each 0.1ms/frame is reference target, requiring real device and measurement resolution/error; unmeasured stays NOT_TESTED.
